questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. An utter state of confusion
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
An utter state of confusion
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Chaos.

Key Points

  • "Chaos" means a state of utter confusion and disorder. (अव्यवस्था)
    • Example: The sudden blackout during the event caused chaos among the audience.
  • It is used to describe situations where no order or organization is present, often leading to panic or disturbance. (अराजकता)
    • Example: The marketplace was in chaos after the unexpected announcement of a curfew.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Chaos.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Pathos (भावुकता): A quality in art or literature that evokes pity or sadness.
    • Example: The movie was filled with pathos, leaving the audience in tears.
  • Engross (डुबाना): To occupy the attention or focus of someone completely.
    • Example: She was so engrossed in her book that she didn’t notice the time.
  • Innuendos (इशारे): Indirect or subtle references, often implying something derogatory.
    • Example: The politician’s speech was filled with innuendos about his opponent.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Meenakshi could have sent a reply.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Meenakshi could have sent a reply.

options.text: A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi.
options.html: A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi.

options.text: A reply could have been sent by Meenakshi.

options.text: A reply could have sent by Meenakshi.
options.html: A reply could have sent by Meenakshi.

options.text: A reply could have been send by Meenakshi.
options.html: A reply could have been send by Meenakshi.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "Meenakshi could have sent a reply."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a reply" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "could have sent" to "could have been sent" (perfect modal passive).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Meenakshi."
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
Correct Sentence: "A reply could have been sent by Meenakshi."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "A reply could have be sent by Meenakshi." – Incorrect verb form (should be "been" instead of "be").
  • Option 3: "A reply could have sent by Meenakshi." – Incorrect structure (missing "been").
  • Option 4: "A reply could have been send by Meenakshi." – Incorrect verb form (should be "sent" instead of "send").

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Lack of interest, enthusiasm or concern

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence. (P) society benefits from diversity (Q) enriching cultures and (O) by fostering understanding and empathy (R) perspectives from around the world
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to
form a meaningful sentence.
(P) society benefits from diversity
(Q) enriching cultures and
(O) by fostering understanding and empathy
(R) perspectives from around the world
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. POQR
Key Points
  • The sentence begins with the subject "society benefits from diversity," which is correctly indicated by part (P).
  • Following the subject, "by fostering understanding and empathy" (PO) continues the logical sequence, making it clear how society benefits.
  • The next part, "enriching cultures and," starts to explain the result of fostering understanding and empathy, indicated by (Q).
  • Ending with "perspectives from around the world," (R) completes the sentence by stating the outcome.
Therefore, the correct answer is POQR.
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1 (QPRO): This option starts with "enriching cultures and society benefits from diversity by fostering understanding and empathy perspectives from around the world." This sequence is incomplete and does not make sense grammatically.
  • Option 3 (RPOQ): This option starts with "perspectives from around the world society benefits from diversity by fostering understanding and empathy enriching cultures and," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
  • Option 4 (ROQP): This option starts with "perspectives from around the world by fostering understanding and empathy enriching cultures and society benefits from diversity," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. The study of ancient things such as art, graves, ruins etc.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The study of ancient things such as art, graves, ruins etc.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 - Archaeology.

Key Points

  • Archaeology refers to the study of ancient things such as art, graves, ruins, and artifacts to understand past civilizations. (प्राचीन वस्तुओं का अध्ययन)
    • Example: Archaeologists discovered an ancient city buried beneath the desert sands.
  • The term originates from the Greek words "archaios" (ancient) and "logos" (study). It involves excavating and analyzing physical remains to reconstruct historical contexts.
    • Example: The Great Pyramids of Egypt are a significant focus of archaeological research. (मिस्र के महान पिरामिड पुरातत्व अध्ययन का एक महत्वपूर्ण केंद्र हैं।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 - Archaeology.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Astrology (ज्योतिष): The study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies as a means of predicting human affairs and natural phenomena.
    • Example: She consulted an astrologer to learn about her future. (उसने अपने भविष्य के बारे में जानने के लिए एक ज्योतिषी से परामर्श किया।)
  • Geology (भूविज्ञान): The scientific study of the Earth's physical structure, substances, history, and processes.
    • Example: The geologist examined the rock layers to determine the area's history. (भूविज्ञानी ने क्षेत्र के इतिहास का निर्धारण करने के लिए चट्टान की परतों की जांच की।)
  • Meteorology (मौसम विज्ञान): The scientific study of the atmosphere, especially as a means of forecasting the weather.
    • Example: The meteorologist predicted heavy rainfall for the weekend. (मौसम विज्ञानी ने सप्ताहांत के लिए भारी वर्षा की भविष्यवाणी की।)

questions.question: Select the term which means the same as the given group of words. A continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse
questions.questionHtml:
Select the term which means the same as the given group of words.
A continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vicious cycle.

Key Points

  • The term "Vicious cycle" refers to a continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse. (दुष्चक्र)
    • Example: Poverty can lead to poor health, which prevents people from working and earning money, thus perpetuating the vicious cycle of poverty.
  • "Vicious cycle" is a process in which a negative event causes another negative event, reinforcing the original problem. (दुष्चक्र)
    • Example: The company's poor performance led to low employee morale, which in turn led to even poorer performance, creating a vicious cycle.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vicious cycle.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Round cycle (गोल चक्र): This term does not specifically refer to a situation where problems cause other problems.
    • Example: The gears in the machine follow a round cycle to complete their function.
  • Repetitive cycle (दोहराने वाला चक्र): This indicates a cycle that repeats but doesn't necessarily involve worsening problems.
    • Example: The repetitive cycle of daily routines can sometimes feel monotonous.
  • Enclosed cycle (बंद चक्र): This term suggests a cycle that is closed or self-contained but does not imply a worsening situation.
    • Example: An enclosed cycle in a chemical process ensures that no materials are lost.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The school will hire new teachers.

  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "The school will hire new teachers."

questions.question: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error. In some countries, you are not able to drink until you are 21.
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
In some countries, you are not able to drink until you are 21.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 (able to drink).

Key Points

  • The phrase "able to drink" is incorrect in this context. The correct form is "not allowed to drink," as "able" implies physical capability, whereas the sentence intends to convey prohibition. (अनुमति नहीं है)
    • Example: You are not allowed to enter without a ticket.
  • The word "allowed" should be used here to indicate that someone is prohibited or restricted from doing something. (स्वीकृत नहीं है)
    • Example: She is not allowed to stay out late.
  • Therefore, the correct sentence is: "In some countries, you are not allowed to drink until you are 21."

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 (able to drink).

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • In some countries, (कुछ देशों में,) This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
    • Example: In some countries, it is customary to remove shoes before entering a home.
  • until you are 21. (जब तक आप 21 साल के नहीं हो जाते।) This part is grammatically correct.
    • Example: You cannot drive until you are 18.
  • you are not (आप नहीं हैं) This part is also grammatically correct.
    • Example: You are not allowed to bring pets into the restaurant.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
